observations: body L1, L11, L35, L36: the dashes of «Arabico–orientali» (6.1 pt) and «5–9» (5.8 pt) are long dashes; the hyphens of «57-58», «Dhū-l-qarnayn» and «178-186» measure 3.0-3.2 pt.

body L3: the jīm written without its dot and its tail («scilicet ح‍») is printed as the initial form of ḥā and transcribed with a zero-width joiner, as in the notes on the tables (S07); so also in note 1 (notes_right L6).
body L6: «{0} 0» has the zero sign of the tables, a filled disc under a short bar, as printed in the notes on the tables (S07).
body L9: a dot below the l of «latit.» is a speck.

notes_left L1-L7, notes_right L1-L6: note 1 runs from the left column into the right; the quotation from Woepcke is French, each of its lines opened by a guillemet. «Muḥammad Sibṭ», «al-Māridīnī» and «Woepcke» are letter-spaced. The thin rule between the columns prints broken.
notes_right L5: the hyphen of «cou-» prints as a dot (1.6 pt long, at the height of a hyphen); it is transcribed as a hyphen.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
